- **`package.json`** — ESM package (`"type": "module"`), pinned exactly to `supports-color@11.0.0` (latest, requires Node ≥22).
- **`index.js`** — `printMessage()` checks `supportsColor.stdout` before wrapping text in ANSI green codes, falling back to plain text otherwise.
- **`bin/cli.js`** — executable entrypoint (`color-cli` bin) that joins argv into a message and prints it.

Verified: `npm install` succeeds, and running the CLI through a pipe (non-TTY) correctly prints plain text with no escape codes, confirming the detection logic works before any colored output is emitted.
